u0: Start state: the ball may still block the door, and the agent lacks the door key. Next objective: clear the ball away from the door cell and pick up the matching key, ideally ending up holding the key while the ball is out of the way. A transition to u1 requires both blocker_moved and has_door_key simultaneously; picking up the target box is only possible after reaching the other room and ends the episode in u3.
u1: Progress state: the ball is out of the way and the agent is carrying the matching door key. Next objective: keep the ball clear, open the locked door, cross into the target room, and pick up the mission box. Dropping the key before the door is open fires key_lost and moves to u2; if the ball is put back in front of the door, the state resets to u0. Picking up the target box succeeds in u3.
u2: Setback state: the ball is still clear of the door, but the agent has lost the matching key before opening the door. Next objective: recover the key by picking it up again to return to u1, or if the ball gets put back in front of the door, return to u0. The door is still closed; regaining the key is required before unlocking and reaching the target box, which would end the episode in u3.
u3: Terminal success state: the agent has picked up the mission's designated target box, ending the episode. No further progress is needed; every subsequent step remains in this final state.
